- API contract: /openapi.yaml
- Interactive API reference: /reference

- Canonical valuation and proof: /guides/valuation-and-proof

- MCP server: https://mcp.dailydraft.fun
- Agent skills: https://github.com/dailydraftfun/skills

The API contract is preview-only until its endpoints are deployed. Never provide
a wallet private key or seed phrase to DailyDraft, its API, MCP server, or an
agent skill.
